summary: Matching game: remove all pairs of cards of the same color before time runs out.
description:
Pair Tiles is a classic puzzle game where you have to find matching pairs of pictures that need to be connected with three straight lines and no other cards blocking their path!  Try plaing the wonderful brain puzzle and challenge your focus and concentration. Match tiles in a puzzle match!
Build your skills with over 100 levels! The Pair Tiles puzzle game is a great way to pass the time! Our match pairs game is as exciting as match 3 games!

Rules:
– The goal of the game is to find two matching pictures and clear the field before the time runs out.
– You need to use all your attention and concentration.
– Select and connect the matching pairs or even triple tiles.
– You can also connect the pictures if they aren't next to each other, but the path to them must be free.

Features:

– A great way to strengthen your concentration, attention, and mind
– Shuffle mode
– 100+ levels of challenges and fun
– The ability to change the sets of images
– Unlimited hints if you get stuck

Try it once, and there'll be no stopping you! Make it all the way to level 100!

Whether you're on a long trip or spending a quiet evening at home, the whole family can relax and do a little brain work. It's also a great way to keep your kids occupied.
